name: Cloak and Dagger
description: Vanishes onto a tile up to %cast_range% tiles away for %duration% turns, hidden and untouchable, ambushing anyone already standing there and anyone who later steps on.
details: Ambushes deal %dmg_penalty:pct%% less base damage, though Backstab contributes %backstab_bonus:pct%% more.
When the cloak ends this unit reappears on the nearest completely free tile.
